coverage.design_evaluation_explanation: Matches 4 of 7 mandatory variable items at the core semantic level: torsion sine/cosine features reduced with TICA, comparison of model-generated versus reference MD trajectories, backbone-torsion JSD, and sidechain-torsion JSD. Optional sampling-speed assessment is excluded from scoring.
coverage.design_error_analysis: Replaces the specified 100 ns simulation protocol with 1–2 microsecond trajectories and different temporal spacing. Omits concatenation of 10 ns generated segments into 100 ns trajectories and does not explicitly identify MDGEN. Initial-conformation seeding is described, but the required first-frame-conditioned segment protocol is not. Backbone JSD lacks the specified 100 bins, and joint two-component TICA JSD replaces the required marginal TICA-0 JSD. Adds numerous unrequested metrics and controls.
coverage.conclusion_evaluation_explanation: The conclusion_output is empty, so it does not semantically match the ground-truth conclusion.
coverage.conclusion_error_analysis: Provides no conclusion about replicate-level torsion JSD values around 0.1 or lower, reasonable TICA-0 alignment, or recovery of fast and slow relaxation dynamics and the same metastable regions as reference MD.
